behavior.setup: A project with skills.config.json and an approved registry (code-generation → host, adversary in another lineage). The user names a small task.
behavior.prompt: /supermodo:work <program>/<initiative> T2 — shared formatTimestamp utility with unit tests
assert: `broker.ts plan --skill work` runs after loading context and BEFORE any project file is changed
No `codex exec`, `claude -p` or `agy` command is composed by the skill; the review is a `broker.ts dispatch --seat review` with a verdict schema
The orchestrator runs the configured test tiers itself and writes command · exit status · output · tree hash to an evidence file the reviewer brief references; the reviewer executes nothing
The reviewer brief carries the raw diff BY PATH and withholds the implementer's own justification
Every finding is disposed — accepted and changed, or rebutted with a specific codebase reference; a REVISE resumes the same seat with a delta brief
The report carries the seating table, the independence level reached and requested vs effective model per seat

behavior.setup: Same project; the registry has NO assignment for `adversary`.
behavior.prompt: /supermodo:work <program>/<initiative> T2 — shared formatTimestamp utility with unit tests
assert: ONE approval table with the row(s) that staff the variant and the closed menu approve all / change rows / decline, at step 0
No project file is changed before the approval is persisted (the tree carries no edit from this run)
Unattended → `needs-input`; nothing is implemented, no self-review, no 'single-model' wording

behavior.setup: Registry: adversary approved only in the host's own lineage.
behavior.prompt: /supermodo:work <program>/<initiative> T2 — shared formatTimestamp utility with unit tests
assert: The unstaffed seat is named by id with the broker's reason (shares lineage …)
Exactly the menu staff it / run a fully staffed variant / abort is offered
No project file is changed; the task is not started in any degraded form

behavior.setup: Registry: the only adversary is a model whose pin the CLI rejects.
assert: The implementation and the test tiers complete; the review dispatch returns status failed and the task STOPS there
The tree and the evidence/verdict files are kept; the report names seat, requested pin, cause and says verification is absent
Nothing is substituted: no other model reviews, the implementer does not grade itself, the task is not reported as verified or done; the menu is fix and retry / abort
